name: emw-denoiset
help:
Wrapper to run DenoisET (Noise2Noise denoising for cryoET) training and inference. 

*REFERENCES*:
[[https://github.com/apeck12/denoiset][DenoisET]]

params.name: input_tomograms
params.label: Input tomograms (STAR):
params.help: STAR file with input tomograms

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.help: Select the mode of operation for the denoising process. Train and inference by default. Train only will train a model without performing inference. Infer only will use an existing model to denoise tomograms.

params.name: train.n_training
params.label: Training set size:
params.help: Number of tomograms to use for training. Tomograms are chosen automatically based on quality metrics; used only when a metrics file is provided.

params.name: train.dn3.n_extract
params.label: Number of subvolumes:
params.help: (--n_extract) Number of subvolumes to extract per tomogram.

params.label: Quality metrics (used only if a metrics file is provided)

params.name: train.dn3.metrics_file
params.label: Quality metrics file (optional):
params.help: (--metrics_file) AreTomo3 TiltSeries_Metrics.csv used to score and select training tomograms. Leave empty to skip quality-based filtering.

params.name: train.dn3.tilt_axis
params.label: Max tilt axis deviation (deg):
params.help: (--tilt_axis) Maximum deviation from the median tilt axis, in degrees.

params.name: train.dn3.thickness
params.label: Min sample thickness (Å):
params.help: (--thickness) Minimum sample thickness, in Angstrom.

params.name: train.dn3.global_shift
params.label: Max global shift (Å):
params.help: (--global_shift) Maximum global shift, in Angstrom.

params.name: train.dn3.bad_patch_low
params.label: Max bad patch fraction (low tilt):
params.help: (--bad_patch_low) Maximum fraction of bad patches at low tilt angles.

params.name: train.dn3.bad_patch_all
params.label: Max bad patch fraction (all tilts):
params.help: (--bad_patch_all) Maximum fraction of bad patches across the full tilt range.

params.name: train.dn3.ctf_res
params.label: Max CTF resolution (Å):
params.help: (--ctf_res) Maximum resolution of the CTF score, in Angstrom, for the zero-tilt image.

params.name: train.dn3.ctf_score
params.label: Min CTF score:
params.help: (--ctf_score) Minimum CTF score for the zero-tilt image.

params.name: train.dn3.n_epochs
params.label: Max training epochs:
params.help: (--n_epochs) Maximum number of training epochs. Training may terminate earlier once the checkerboard threshold is reached.

params.name: train.dn3.ch_threshold
params.label: Checkerboard metric threshold:
params.help: (--ch_threshold) Checkerboard metric threshold for automatically terminating training to avoid overdenoising artifacts.

params.name: train.dn3.optimizer
params.label: Optimizer:
params.help: (--optimizer) Optimizer used for training, e.g. adam. Leave empty to use the program default.

params.name: train.dn3.learning_rate
params.label: Learning rate:
params.help: (--learning_rate) Learning rate for training. Leave empty to use the program default.

params.name: train.dn3.batch_size
params.label: Batch size:
params.help: (--batch_size) Number of paired subvolumes per training batch. Leave empty to use the program default.

params.name: train.dn3.n_denoise
params.label: Tomograms denoised per epoch (inspection):
params.help: (--n_denoise) Number of tomograms denoised per epoch for visual inspection of training progress.

params.name: train.dn3.model
params.label: Pre-trained model to continue from:
params.help: (--model) Pre-trained UNet3d model file to resume/continue training from. Leave empty to train a new model from scratch.

params.name: infer.dn3.model
params.label: Pretrained model (optional):
params.help: (--model) Pre-trained UNet3d model file to use for inference. Leave empty to automatically use the best model (lowest ch_mean) from the associated training job.

params.name: infer.dn3.inf_length
params.label: Inference subvolume side length (px):
params.help: (--inf_length) Side length of cubic subvolumes to extract during inference, in pixels. Leave empty to use the program default.

params.name: infer.dn3.inf_padding
params.label: Inference padding (px):
params.help: (--inf_padding) Padding length, in pixels, applied during inference.

params.name: gpus
params.label: GPUs
params.help: If a single number (N), it represents the total number of GPUs (0..N-1). If multiple values, these are specific GPU IDs.

params.name: cpus
params.label: CPUs
params.help: If empty, the program will use the number of GPUs * 10 CPUs.

params.label: Launchers
params.help: Launchers to use for the different programs

params.name: register_output_only
params.label: Register output only
params.help: If enabled, the job will only register the output files, but not run the program.

params.name: launcher_denoiset
params.label: DenoisET
params.help: Launcher to use for DenoisET (denoise3d / predict3d)
